CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

March 12, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: February 27, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the February 27, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Herandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1815 South Stoneman Avenue, DRB-2023-00092

  •  Request: This is an application for a 524 SF addition to the 1st floor, 432 SF
  addition to the 2nd floor, and re-design of the front patio for an existing 1-story
  Craftsman-style house.

  1
   •  Applicant: Timmy Tiet
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chair Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions:
  1) The applicant must provide exterior lighting product information or
  specifications for the City Architect to review and approve.
  2) Any future changes to the exterior doors will require review and approval by
  the City Staff.
  3) The applicant shall revise the rafter tails to be graphically accurate in all
  elevations.
  4) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings, according to the
  conditions listed in this motion, for the City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  108-188 South Monterey Street, DRB-2023-00221

  •  Request: This is an application for a Master Sign Program for tenants’ signage
  on an approved 5-story mixed-use building with commercial at ground floor
  including ten (10) tenant spaces/units fronting South Monterey Street and Bay
  State Street.
  •  Applicant: Lavender Fung
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Recused: Board member Tsai was recused from this discussion item #3.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions:
  1) The applicant shall revise Sheet #12 to identify the logo symbol and state if
  the logo is optional for tenant signage.
  2) The applicant may refer to the Planning Department for final determination on
  wording/language used for the ‘commercial parking’ signs on the project.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Recused:  Tsai
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ITEM 4:  116 North Granada Avenue, DRB-2024-00002

  •  Request: This is an application for exterior remodel of an existing 2-story 2,648
  SF single-family residence (Unit #1), an existing 1-story 576 SF single-family
  residence (Unit #2), and an existing 1-story 440 SF detached garage, consisting
  of re-roofing, and window and door replacements.
  •  Applicant: Fengjun Li
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Recused: Board member Tsai was recused from this discussion item #4.

MOTION:
  • Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with conditions as
  follows:
  1) The applicant shall revise the proposed ‘Shiplap Board’ to match in similar
  size, type, and color as existing.
  2) The applicant shall revise the proposed exterior door selection to be of a
  Craftsman style.
  3) The applicant shall revise the exterior lighting to be of a Craftsman style.
  4) The applicant should remove the first image of the proposed ‘Primed Shiplap
  Board’ on Sheet A-7.
  5) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  • The second was by Board member Hernandez.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Recused:  Tsai
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  1720 West Hellman Avenue, DRB-2022-00063

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 628 SF addition to an existing single-
  family residence, including an addition to the 1st and 2nd floor, a new storage
  space, uncovered balcony, and front porch re-design.
  •  Applicant: Seth Sor
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval: 1) The applicant shall provide
  additional window product information and/or specifications; 2) The applicant shall
  provide additional door product information and/or specifications; and 3) The
  applicant shall provide the proposed door and window design information for City
  Architect to review and approve.

MOTION:
  • Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with conditions as
  follows:
  1) The applicant shall provide additional window product information and/or
  specifications.

  3
   2) The applicant shall provide additional door product information and/or
  specifications.
  3) The applicant shall provide the proposed door and window design information
  for City Architect to review and approve.
  4) The project shall provide window grids and shutters where appropriate on the
  West Elevation.
  5) The applicant shall revise the front door to be either a wider double-swing
  door or a minimum 4 foot wide single-swing door and select a door style that
  aligns with the proposed architectural style.
  6) The proposed railing and post shall be consistent throughout the project in
  terms of railing style and materials.
  7) The applicant shall revise the 2nd floor covered balcony opening to be wider
  or to give the appearance of being more open to the outside.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:24 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on March 26, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Ng moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:24 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
